comment: Every flattened path present on one side only must be declared here, or the run fails (K9). A pair compares the old path's value with the new path's value; none_equals is the Debug value a None on the old side stands for (the new field's clap default), so a family that leaves the name unset is not reported as unequal.

pairs.why: BILLING_MODE had two readers at rc.4 (the clap flag and the env copy BillingConfig.mode_env that the readiness gate read); HEAD reads only the clap-resolved value. Equal-effective whenever the flag is not given on argv.
ROLLUP: the same reader split as BILLING_MODE.

no fork-debt reconciler: fork references a deleted child still owed were released only by the paths that existed at rc.4
